data.one_liner: A progress bar widget to show or change the position of an audio or video stream.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable progress bar widget for audio and video playback. It supports displaying current progress, buffered status, and total duration while allowing users to seek through streams via touch or drag gestures.
use_when: You need a progress bar for an audio or video player.
You want to display buffered status alongside playback progress.
You need an alternative to the standard Flutter Slider that is easier to connect to media players.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete media player UI kit including play/pause buttons out of the box.
strengths: Easy to connect to any audio or video player providing duration states.
Supports displaying buffered status for streamed media.
Highly customizable colors, sizes, and time label locations.
weaknesses: Does not play audio or video itself.
Does not include playback control buttons like start and pause.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a feature-rich audio player plugin that can power the media playback logic behind your progress bar.
